name: Produces Check
description: A workflow declares a job whose check run carries a context some ruleset requires — the machinery that satisfies the gate. DERIVED from job display names, and honest about it: `confidence` says whether the declared name equals the context or is the template a matrix job expands into. Emitted only toward contexts a rule requires and only when the requirement allows an Actions-produced check (integration null or 15368); a required Actions context with no producer in a repository is visible as a check node with no inbound edge from that repository's workflows. A producer edge means the workflow produces a check run with this name VIA GITHUB ACTIONS (integration 15368); whether that satisfies a particular requirement is read per requirement from REQUIRES_CHECK.integration_id — when two rulesets name one context, one App-only and one Actions, the node carries producers for the second while the first still requires an App. Compatibility is never a property of the shared node.

job_key.description: The YAML key of the job whose check run carries the context.

job_name.description: The job's display name as declared — the string GitHub names the check run with.

confidence.description: `exact`: the declared display name equals the required context. `matrix_template`: the context is the declared name followed by a parenthesised matrix expansion (`test (3.12)` for a job named `test`), so the producer is inferred from the template, not observed as the context.
